name: doge_alignment
short: D&D alignment chart for your server, drawn with members' avatars
description: A 3x3 D&D alignment chart per server, drawn as one picture or as a gallery of nine, with members' avatars. Custom labels and colours, suggestions that members accept or reject, guesses from a local language model, alignment admins, YAML export and import. Slash and text commands (`alignment`). Needs ImageMagick (libmagickwand, plus its Pango coder for emoji) on the bot's host; without it the chart is shown as text.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores your alignment, display name and avatar URL for each server's chart, whether you are an alignment admin there, pending alignment suggestions for and by you, and whether you allow guesses. `alignment guess` sends random stretches of your messages in a server, the conversations around them (other people anonymised), your posting pattern and your avatar to the bot owner's own language model; nothing from it is stored. `alignment guessing false` blocks guesses about you and hides your words when others are guessed, `alignment remove` takes you off a chart, and Red's data deletion removes you everywhere.
